title: Wo Long 2: Wings of Ember Sets March 2027 Release Date
summary: KOEI TECMO and Team NINJA have announced a March 4, 2027 release date for Wo Long 2: Wings of Ember, alongside a limited-time Alpha Demo.
content:
KOEI TECMO and Team NINJA have officially announced the release date for Wo Long 2: Wings of Ember. The dark Three Kingdoms action RPG is scheduled to launch worldwide on March 4, 2027.

The game takes players to China in 208 AD, following the events of Wo Long: Fallen Dynasty. The new adventure expands the series with a new setting, characters, story, and combat systems.

Alongside the release date announcement, an Alpha Demo became available for a limited time on supported platforms. Players can use the demo to experience part of the game's action before the full release.

Wo Long 2 is planned for Xbox Series X|S, PlayStation 5, Nintendo Switch 2, Xbox on PC, and Steam. The game will also be available through Xbox Game Pass at launch.

The announcement gives fans of the series a clearer look at what Team NINJA is preparing for the next chapter of the Wo Long franchise.
